## Timeline.svelte

### `interface TimelineEvent`

- `title` :: The heading for this event.
- `description` :: Optional supporting copy.
- `time` :: When the event happened, shown as a quiet timestamp.
- `icon` :: An icon drawn in the rail instead of the default dot.
- `tone` :: Colour of the rail marker.

### `interface Props`

- `items` :: The events to render. When omitted, `children` (usually `TimelineItem`s) are used.
- `align` :: Which side of the rail the bodies sit on.
- `alternate` :: Swings the bodies to both sides of the rail, alternating item by item.
- `children` :: Custom items, used when `items` is omitted.

## TimelineItem.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `title` :: The heading for this event.
- `description` :: Optional supporting copy.
- `time` :: When the event happened, shown as a quiet timestamp.
- `icon` :: An icon drawn in the rail instead of the default dot.
- `tone` :: Colour of the rail marker.
- `textSize` :: The scale of the description, the timestamp and the marker glyph.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the description.
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the timestamp.
- `shape` :: The corner treatment of the marker.
- `children` :: Extra content under the description.
